reference.name: Category Contains '_' returns all 200 Products including categories without underscores
reference.summary: Category Contains '_' returns all 200 Products including categories without underscores.
reference.expected: Contains '_' should match category text containing a literal underscore, not categories such as Gizmo, Gadget, Widget or Doohickey.
reference.actual: The applied Category contains _ filter returns 200 rows. Visible rows include Gizmo, Doohickey, Gadget and Widget, none containing an underscore.
reproSteps: Start a new question in the notebook using Sample Database > Products.
Add a Category filter, select Contains, enter a single underscore (_) and leave Case sensitive unchecked.
Add the filter and click Visualize.
Observe 200 returned rows including categories Gizmo, Gadget, Doohickey and Widget.
